name: Balanced Hypergraph Partitioning
problem_statement: Partition vertices of a weighted hypergraph into balanced parts while minimizing a declared hyperedge cut objective.

normalization: Preserve vertex identities and hyperedge incidence sets.
Duplicate vertices within one hyperedge are invalid.
Do not replace hyperedges with clique expansion without an explicitly different objective.

problem_inputs.name: imbalance_tolerance
problem_inputs.description: Nonnegative fractional excess over ideal part weight.

required_outputs.name: feasible
required_outputs.description: Whether the balance constraints are met.

solution_semantics.objective: Minimize weighted hyperedge cut cost subject to balance.
solution_semantics.exactness: Heuristic optimization; feasibility and objective recomputation are exact checks.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: Output identities refer to the normalized input; any multiplicities must follow the declared task.
solution_semantics.ordering: No output order or choice among equally valid optima is required unless specified by an input.

validation_rules: Every vertex belongs to one part.
Recompute part weights and hyperedge cut cost.
edge_cases: An overweight indivisible vertex may make balance infeasible.

correctness: Every vertex belongs to one part.
Recompute part weights and hyperedge cut cost.
